notes.title: AWA 2024 released
notes.content:
Hello everyone! AWA 2024, the heavily remastered version of AWA is now live on Steam! Enjoy!
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2687850/AWA_2024/

AWA 2024 is a heavily remastered version of the original game. The modifications include a transition to a HD 16:9 gameplay screen, improved bullet patterns for the enemies, much improved graphics with a pixel art look for nostalgia, brand new soundtrack and sound effects, two new aircraft to unlock and a lot more. About the original: AWA (Aircraft Warfare Arcade) is a fast paced shoot-em-up featuring modern military aircraft. Choose one of the ten fighter aircraft and take the battle to the skies throughout nine action-packed stages each with their own special end-level boss.

FEATURES

* 9 action-packed stages each with their own end-level boss
* 10 player fighter aircraft to choose from
* Money system – earn money with every mission, upgrade or repair your fighter aircraft/buy support drones or special weapons
* Full controller support
* Multi-stage level bosses
* 3 difficulty levels
* Unlockable player fighter aircraft
* Online Leaderboards
* Achievements

XBOX controller fully supported in-game, partially support for game menus.

notes.title: AWA UPDATE 2
notes.content:
[h1]AWA UPDATE 2[/h1] is live and these are the main additions/fixes included:

Updates:

* added [b]TATE[/b] mode support (can be set in the GAMEPLAY tab in the OPTIONS menu)
* [b]new player jet fighter[/b] unlock-able at 220 stars - the LIGHTNING
* [b]improved the skins[/b] for the FULCRUM, EAGLE, TYPHOON and RAPTOR to give them a more "arcade" look

Fixes:

* fixed several menu navigation issues with various controllers  

Important notes

* players using an XBONE controller please update to the latest driver
* controlling the player aircraft with a mouse in TATE mode is not yet supported

Have fun!

notes.title: AWA UPDATE 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here's our first update for AWA based on the community feedback and features we already wanted to implement.

* a new player aircraft is now available - the legendary Tomcat, unlockable at 200 stars
* added health bars to end-mission bosses
* added the possibility of controlling the player aircraft with the mouse (selectable in the Gameplay tab in the Options menu)
* added extra graphics in the aircraft select menu showing the aircraft shooting patterns

Bug fixes:

* the game will now save the option tu run in windowd mode
* the game music will no longer play when the "game over" music plays

Have fun!

notes.title: AWA Patch 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We just released a new patch that solves the following issues:

* solved a few issues with the player controls when changing them from the Gameplay tab in the options menu
* the player fighter could remain still in some situations with the player being unable to move it
